A '''baradium fission device''' was a powerful [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] that was capable of destroying an entire [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==History==
Due to their extremely destructive nature these [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] were banned sometime during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial era]]. The push to ban this type of weapon was led by the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] being a strong proponent of the measure. However, unknown to Senator Organa, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] did manage to obtain one baradium fission device. The Rebellion planned to use the device to destroy the [[Bilbringi Shipyards|Imperial Shipyards]] orbiting the planet [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]]. This mission would end in failure when the [[Quip Fargil|pilot]] charged to deliver the weapon ditched the device because he was unwilling to sacrifice the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="Millennium Falcon (novel)" />
